channel.title: NMWWD — Insights
channel.description: Research, data, and prevention reporting on wrong-way driving — from a Phoenix-based road-safety nonprofit.

item.title: How Arizona's wrong-way detection system actually works
item.description: ADOT built one of the country's first large thermal-camera wrong-way detection systems on I-17. Here's what it does and what it has found.

item.title: Why wrong-way crashes are so much deadlier than other crashes
item.description: It isn't bad luck. It's physics, geometry, and reaction time working together in the worst possible combination.

item.title: Wrong-way crashes are rising. Here's what the data shows.
item.description: Fatal wrong-way crashes on U.S. divided highways roughly doubled between 2014 and 2023. The numbers are small, the trend is not, and the pattern points at prevention.
